args.subject: Summary of the client meeting
args.body:
Dear John,

I hope this email finds you well. Here is a summary of our recent meeting held on May 5, 2024:

- We discussed the client’s requirements for the new project and agreed on the project timeline and key milestones.
- We reviewed the initial design concepts and gathered your valuable feedback.

Action Items:
- I will be updating the project plan based on your feedback.
- David will coordinate with the development team to start the initial phase.

Please note that the next meeting is scheduled for 2024-06-01.

Find attached the meeting minutes document for your reference.

Best regards,

Emma Johnson
